approved_translation: Choose friends wisely; true friends stand by you in times of danger.
translation_author: Ellen C. Babbitt (retold from traditional sources)
context_summary: A family of Hawks lived on an island in a lake not far from the great forest. On the northern shore of this lake lived a Lion, King of Beasts. Then the Kingfisher and the Turtle came up, and the Hawks said: "You have saved us. Friends in need are friends indeed."
interpretation_boundaries: Do not depict specific historical Buddha figures — keep characters as generic animals or people
